text: No, the whole property was not cleared in 2021. While there was tree-cover loss within the asset during that year, it amounted to only about 81.3 hectares, which is roughly 2.23% of the total property area (3,643.5 hectares). The loss occurred in patches primarily within planted forest (68.1 hectares of Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda), with the rest outside mapped forest areas. This indicates selective or localized clearing rather than a full property clearance.
